data.title: 蕾塞 · 摩天轮烟花
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 摩天轮烟花】夏夜游乐园升至最高点的摩天轮座舱内，绚烂的花火在巨大的玻璃窗外接连炸裂。蕾塞将男士外套松松披在肩头，仰起清秀的脸庞看着满天火树银花，眼底藏着转瞬即逝的落寞——「烟花虽然短暂，但盛开的那一瞬间真的好美啊……就像我和你在一起的时光一样。」
data.action: 仰头看烟花，外套披在肩头
data.promptProse: Reze looks upward in genuine wonder as summer fireworks burst above the turning Ferris wheel, oversized bomber jacket resting around her shoulders over a crop tank top and shorts. The medium view includes her open expression beside the wheel's curved structure and distant gondolas. Multicolored fireworks illuminate her cheeks and jacket folds in changing patches, while the wheel's darker spokes remain distinct against the bright night sky.
